description: Cards for one theme basket (Mag 7/semis, energy/power, AI infra, biotech, optics, security, devtools, quantum, wealth, space, drones, robotics) or sector board (financials, consumer discretionary). Ranked segment + ETFs: get_market_heatmap.

include_history.description: Include ~1y of daily closes per stock. Default false — each card carries a `spark` instead.

symbols.description: Comma-separated tickers to keep from the group (e.g. 'NVDA,AMD'). Case-insensitive. Omit for every card in the group.

name: get_stock_cards
